Interaction plots

Source: R/plots.R
cr_plot_interaction.Rd

Means of dv across x_var for each level of trace, as dots joined by dashed lines with error bars (categorical x_var), or as predicted lines with confidence ribbons (continuous x_var). From a model, the means are the model's predictions; from a data frame, raw means (or linear fits for a continuous x_var).

Usage

cr_plot_interaction(
  x,
  dv,
  x_var,
  trace,
  uncertainty = c("ci", "se", "sd", "none"),
  palette = NULL,
  style = "nature",
  n_points = 50,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A clean_results object or a data frame.

dv

Outcome.

x_var

Variable on the x-axis.

trace

Variable whose levels get separate lines.

uncertainty

Error bars: "se", "ci" (default), "sd" (raw data only), or "none".

palette

Palette name or colors (see cr_palette()).

style

Theme style passed to theme_cr().

n_points

For a continuous x_var: points along its range.

conf_level

Confidence level for "ci".

...

Passed to cr_plot_means() for a categorical x_var.

Value

A ggplot object.
